protocol.chronology: versions always added in release order; conditions/replicate jobs shuffled; warmups precede formal jobs
protocol.controls: Same Python pipeline/profile: only boundary scan switches Python/Rust; legacy 1MiB archive and shared fixed CAS controls. No transform or model.
protocol.integrity: all restoration paths/bytes compared; CAS config/snapshot/stored/raw/file hashes; archive original checks
protocol.cost: all logical files, object headers, snapshot/config records, orphans; allocated data extents separately, directory/MFT/journal not counted
protocol.cache: pre-read selected snapshot records/referenced objects or full archive; warm OS cache; no decoded-data cache
protocol.matching: actual request fingerprints match all conditions within version/round/category; fixed 64KiB cross-window grid
protocol.timing: add includes compression, verification/reuse, object/snapshot fsync/publish; allocation/tree audit untimed; shared setup separate but included in sequence total
protocol.rss: sequence encoding separate worker, includes untimed storage ledger; each restoration separate worker; range includes truth and metadata ledger
protocol.native: Explicit frozen CI binary; first add includes hash/provenance checking and CDLL load. Python still assembles chunks, hashes, verifies, compresses, fsyncs and publishes. Restores/reads use identical Python CAS readers; timing differences there are not Rust decoder gains.
protocol.native_cost: Full DLL+native.json reported once separately, then added to shared logical cost for a single deployment; common Python/codec/OS costs unallocated.

limits: one scientific corpus family, three real releases; no universal deduplication/CDC result
gear-v1 is a simple single-mask profile, not a reproduction or speed claim for FastCDC
shared immutable CAS; failed adds can leave counted orphan objects; no garbage collection or power-loss guarantee
all sources still read/hashed; CAS adds do not skip source scanning; no neural prediction or semantic reasoning result

native_provenance.scope: CSV inverse and Gear boundary scan; not a complete archive/CAS implementation
